page.overview:
Who is Doniella Alievin?

Her name indicates that she was from Cairhien.

Doniella held the position for twenty-six years until her resignation in . She was Serenia Latar's successor and Aliane Senican's predecessor., Chapter 24 The White Tower}}

Doniella was a quiet Amyrlin, not particularly strong, but not in the control of the Hall, either; her benign neglect did leave the Hall pretty much in control of the Tower.

Doniella quite voluntarily resigned as Amyrlin in order to spend more time on her loved studies. She spent the next thirty-one years studying happily, however she was not allowed to return to the Tower and was strongly discouraged from letting anyone know that she had been the Amyrlin Seat.
